questions.question: Before stopping your vehicle at a traffic signal or sign, you should:

options.text: Press down hard on the accelerator.
Check your mirrors for surrounding traffic.
Set the parking brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors for surrounding traffic.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors first. Be aware of other drivers. Release the accelerator and slow down. Move your foot to the brake and press steadily for a smooth stop.

questions.question: If a motorist sees pedestrians in an upcoming crosswalk, what should the motorist do?

options.text: Continue ahead. The motorist has the right-of-way.
Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
Pull to the right and go around the pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
questions.explanation: You must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians in a crosswalk. Wait until they finish crossing before you go.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts to cross the street after the "Don't Walk" signal begins to flash. The pedestrian is in the middle of the street when your signal light changes to green. You should:

options.text: Proceed if you have the right-of-way.
Proceed if the pedestrian is not in your lane.
Wait until the pedestrian crosses the street before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the pedestrian crosses the street before proceeding.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, you must give the right-of-way to anyone in the intersection. Wait until the pedestrian has fully crossed before you proceed.

questions.question: A school bus is stopped ahead of you in your lane with its red lights flashing. You should:

options.text: Stop and proceed when you think all of the children have exited the bus.
Slow to 25 mph and pass cautiously.
Stop for as long as the red lights are flashing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop for as long as the red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when you see a school bus with flashing red lights. Stay stopped until the lights stop flashing. You do not need to stop if the bus is on the other side of a divided highway.

questions.question: When taking any medicine, you should:

options.text: Consult your doctor about the effects before driving.
Have someone follow you home.
Keep your window open and drive more slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Consult your doctor about the effects before driving.
questions.explanation: Medicines can affect your ability to drive safely. Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before driving if you take any new medicine. This is especially important for tranquilizers or sedatives.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No passing zone.
Slow-moving vehicle.
Two-way traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zone.
questions.explanation: A yellow triangle sign with black words means no passing zone. You will see it on the left side of a two-lane road where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: When should drivers yield the right-of-way to pedestrians in a crosswalk?

options.text: Only if the pedestrians first wave to the driver.
Only if the pedestrians are not texting while walking.
At all times.

questions.correctAnswerText: At all times.
questions.explanation: Always stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk. Give them the right-of-way. You may go only when your path is completely clear.

questions.question: If a vehicle is equipped with airbags:

options.text: Seat belts should still be worn.
Seat belts do not need to be worn.
Seat belts should be worn behind the back.

questions.correctAnswerText: Seat belts should still be worn.
questions.explanation: Airbags and seat belts work together. Always wear your seat belt, even in vehicles with airbags. This gives you the best protection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicle, bicycle, or pedestrian pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: When turning left at an intersection:

options.text: You should always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Oncoming traffic and pedestrians should yield to you.
You should never yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: When turning left, yield the right-of-way to oncoming traffic and pedestrians. Wait until the intersection is clear and the signal allows before you turn.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly blows out while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and move out of the traffic lane.
Pump the brakes quickly.
Brake hard and steer toward the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and move out of the traffic lane.
questions.explanation: If your tire blows out, do not panic. Hold the steering wheel firmly and take your foot off the gas to let the vehicle slow down. Gently apply the brakes when it is safe. Do not move to the side of the road until the car has slowed down enough.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn.
Intersection ahead.
Lane change.

questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: When you meet an aggressive driver, what should you do?

options.text: Challenge them.
Get out of their way.
Speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of their way.
questions.explanation: All drivers must respect each other and follow traffic rules to stay safe. When you meet an aggressive driver, the safest thing is to let them pass. Never compete with other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Service sign.
Regulatory sign.
Warning sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning sign.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions ahead. These could include a change in traffic direction, a steep downgrade, or other hazards that require you to take action.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
You have the right-of-way.
Let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path before you proceed. Stop if needed.

questions.question: Reaction time becomes slower after:

options.text: Drinking alcohol.
Sleeping.
Working hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drinking alcohol.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reflexes and reaction time. It also reduces your ability to see clearly and makes you less alert. As you drink more, your judgment gets worse and your driving skills decrease. You will have trouble judging distances, speeds, and how other vehicles are moving.

questions.question: As daylight fades, what should you use to help others see you?

options.text: Parking lights.
Low beam headlights.
Emergency flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: As daylight fades, turn on your low beam headlights so others can see you. Only use high beam headlights in open areas where no other drivers are nearby.

questions.question: Delaware law does not give anyone the right-of-way. Instead, it says:

options.text: Who must yield the right-of-way.
Nothing about the right-of-way.
The right-of-way does not exist.

questions.correctAnswerText: Who must yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Delaware traffic law does not give anyone the right-of-way. The law explains who must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: Why should you not stop suddenly in front of large trucks and buses?

options.text: Small vehicle drivers cannot see large trucks and buses well in their rearview mirrors.
Large trucks and buses need longer distances to stop because of their size and weight.
Large trucks and buses travel faster than small vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large trucks and buses need longer distances to stop because of their size and weight.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles need more space and time to stop than smaller vehicles. A sudden stop in front of a large vehicle is dangerous because the driver may not be able to stop in time to avoid a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A divided highway is ending ahead.
A divided highway is starting ahead.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway is starting ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: Only ____ can lower blood alcohol concentration (BAC).

options.text: Drinking caffeine
Eating foods high in fat
Time

questions.correctAnswerText: Time
questions.explanation: Your body needs time to remove alcohol from your system. Nothing else, including eating or drinking, can speed up this process.

questions.question: You see a pedestrian crossing your lane with no crosswalk ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Make eye contact and then pass the pedestrian.
Slow down as you pass the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians crossing your lane, even if there is no crosswalk. Always let them cross safely.

questions.question: Where should children age 12 and under sit in a vehicle with airbags?

options.text: The front seat.
The back seat.
The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The back seat.
questions.explanation: Airbags can hurt children. Children age 12 and under must sit in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: What can you do to reduce road rage?

options.text: Always signal when changing lanes.
Talk on your cell phone while driving.
Use your horn frequently.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal when changing lanes.
questions.explanation: To prevent road rage, follow all traffic laws and signs. Always signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.
Winding road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers of road conditions. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A railroad crossing is ahead. Get ready to stop.
You will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing is ahead. Get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is coming. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: When should you adjust your rearview and side mirrors?

options.text: Before you start driving.
Whenever you need to use them.
Before you get into the car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Adjust your mirrors before you start driving. Do not adjust them while the car is moving. Also adjust your seat and fasten your seatbelt before driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is roadwork ahead.
You must change lanes ahead.
There is a detour ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is roadwork ahead.
questions.explanation: Orange signs mean construction is ahead. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What should you do if the road is wet or icy?

options.text: Reduce your speed.
Drive at the posted speed.
Speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Wet or icy roads reduce tire grip. Slow down when the road is wet or icy.
